title: knowledge(web-services): describe API objects intended for MCP tools
summary: BCQuality adds guidance for API objects intended for MCP tools to describe entities using AboutText, EntitySetCaption, or EntityName, with good and bad code samples and updated regression testing infrastructure.
key_points: New web-services knowledge article documents the metadata description precedence for API pages and queries used by MCP server
Good and bad AL samples show proper AboutText usage for document-type filters and computed values
Evaluation framework enhanced with optional articleOverrides and cleanContexts for context-specific testing
Regression test harness corrected to properly exit with status 0 after assertions complete
Context applicability scoped to BC 28+ online environments with MCP support
